title: apricity-cli: --steps <track> on export --kit, with help, errors and docs
description:
## Intent

Expose the MIDI export on the command line and document it.

## Scope

- `--steps <track>` on `apricity export --kit` (crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs): writes `<track>.mid` next to the preset (or next to `-o`); `--force` covers both files; nothing written if either would fail.
- `--help` line and example; errors and warnings as in the story; success line `wrote b.adg (8 pads) and b.mid (16 notes)`.
- Docs: docs/tools.md (the flag and how to use the two files together in the DAW), docs/glossary.md ("MIDI file" only if not already defined), `design/daw-presets.md` MIDI section and the "what cannot travel" table.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test export_cli
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
All M2 scenarios green.

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): apricity export --kit --steps`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the pad-notes task.
